newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Former WA premier Burke guilty of stealing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Former WA premier Burke guilty of stealing.

text.p: Former Western Australia premier Brian Burke was on Friday found guilty on seven charges of stealing up to A$122,000 from the Australian Labor Party to buy stamps.
District Court Judge George Sadleir said he had found the offences proved beyond reasonable doubt.
Burke stole the money, which was donated to his Australian Labor Party leader's fund, between 1984 and 1988 when he was premier of Western Australia.
The court was immediately adjourned and was expected to reconvene later in the day for arguments over sentencing.
